question.message:
Case values that no project file gives — all from `knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md` (the assumptions document of this competition case), plus the time zone and the two tolerances. Approve all, change some, or stop.

TIME ZONE (needed: the CSV dates carry no offset and gemini has no default zone)
- time_zone of both demand series = UTC | assumption, no file states it | the brief's dates are calendar days; gemini's own sample case uses UTC timestamps

DEMAND — return side and cooling indoor values (the brief fixes only the 100 °C and 20 °C supplies)
- demand.heating.return_temperature = 60 degC | design choice, the brief leaves it to the team | below the 100 degC supply
- demand.heating.return_pressure = 6 bar | assumptions document (team)
- demand.cooling.return_temperature = 25 degC | design choice, the brief leaves it to the team | above the 20 degC supply
- demand.cooling.return_pressure = 4 bar | assumptions document (team)
- demand.cooling.dew_point_margin = 1 K | assumptions document (team)
- demand.cooling.indoor_temperature = 26 degC | assumptions document (team)
- demand.cooling.indoor_relative_humidity = 0.5 | assumptions document (team; 50 % as a fraction)

SITE — air and brine
- site.air.temperature = 10 degC (constant) | assumptions document (team)
- site.air.pressure = 101325 Pa | assumptions document (team)
- site.fluid.sand_concentration = 20 mg/l | assumptions document (team)

UTILITIES
- utilities.electricity.co2_intensity = 300 g/kWh | organisers (Discord #technical-q-and-a, 2026-11-04), location-based grid average
- utilities.gas.composition (bought natural gas, mole fraction) = CH4 0.8249507401227822, C2H6 0.039549858193534584, C3H8 0.012748086337494389, CO2 0.011912342910726407, N2 0.11083897243546233 | assumptions document (team; digits as written, not rounded)

UNCERTAINTY (ranges the assumptions document gives with the value)
- site.ground.gradient = 30 °C/km with uncertainty normal, std 2 K/km, min 25, max 35 K/km | assumptions document (team)
- site.reservoir.permeability = 200 mD with uncertainty triangular, min 100, max 400 mD | assumptions document (team)

REQUIREMENT TOLERANCES (the brief says "demand met" and "equal volumes" but gives no tolerance)
- heat_delivered: heating_supply unmet_share max 0.01 | assumptions document (1 % of the year's heat demand, all 365 days)
- cold_delivered: cooling_supply unmet_share max 0.01 | assumptions document (1 % of the year's cold demand, all 365 days)
- full_reinjection: doublet reinjection_ratio min 0.99999, max 1.00001, each step while running | assumptions document (band around 1)

Set from the files without asking: time 2027-01-01 to 2028-01-01 at 1 d; both demand series; heating supply 100 degC and cooling supply 20 degC; reservoir 2500 m / 100 m / 250 barg / 200 mD; gradient 30 °C/km; surface 12 degC; brine 1030 kg/m3, 0.4 mPa.s, GLR 0.8 Nm3/m3, produced gas CH4 0.8 / CO2 0.2; and the 8 requirements of the brief (flow 50–300 m3/h, brine cooling ≤ 40 K, 330 d, pump efficiency 0.7, 1–3 doublets, plus the two tolerances above).

Allow set_case (write)?

Change the case: format, kind, name, time.start, time.end, time.step and 37 more; files GEMINI_Heating_Demand_Daily_2027.csv, GEMINI_Cooling_Demand_Daily_2027.csv.

The case is now stored from the challenge brief and the two daily demand files (site, reservoir, brine, both demand series, and the 8 requirements). The one part still open is the case's economics, which no competition file gives. All of it comes from `knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md`, the assumptions document of this competition case, in EUR of 2015: discount rate 0.05, analysis period 25 yr, electricity 105.75 EUR/MWh, natural gas 39.92 EUR/MWh, CO2 57.03 EUR/t, heat and cold revenue 60 EUR/MWh each, heat cost share 0.8, CH4 GWP 29.8, chemicals 3 EUR/kg and waste disposal 0.2 EUR/kg, plus the capital-cost and fixed-opex table per equipment kind (drilling 1239.1304347826087 EUR/m, heat pump 0.73786 EUR/W, gas boiler 0.06073 EUR/W, CHP 0.96155 EUR/W, degasser 1,000,000 EUR, chillers 0.3 EUR/W, pumps 0.5 EUR/W, heat exchanger 0.5 EUR/(W/K), flare 100,000 EUR, gas make-up 50,000 EUR, cooler 0.1 EUR/W, pipe 500 EUR/m). No subsidy and no per-MWh chiller price is set. Do you approve these economics values for the case?

options.label: Approve all (recommended)
options.value: approve all economics values from knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md
